issue.body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

The `disabled` property  of `form_submit_button` stops the user from clicking the button and submitting the form. However, that behavior is overridden by the "Press Enter to submit form" shortcut from input components such as `text_input`.   `form_submit_button` should stay `False` if it's disabled. 

![press_to_enterForm](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/34405119/e2847616-e557-4c0e-8941-d8a3da083bc4)



### Reproducible Code Example

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-7822)

```Python
import streamlit as st

with st.form("Form"): 
    st.text_input("Enter text:")
    submit = st.form_submit_button("Submit", disabled=True)

if submit:  
    "## 😵 Disabled form was submitted ?"
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Enter some text in the form text_input. 
2. Press Enter
3. 🤔 The form was submitted

### Expected Behavior

The form should not be submitted because `form_submit_button` is disabled. 

### Current Behavior

_No response_

### Is this a regression?

- [X] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.29.0
- Python version: 3.11
- Operating System: Ubuntu 20.04.6
- Browser: Firefox


### Additional Information

This is a bug introduced in version 1.25.0 with the "Press Enter to submit form" shortcut. Check this example from @snehankekre on discuss when this was not an issue:

https://discuss.streamlit.io/t/is-there-a-way-to-disable-st-form-submit-button-after-input/35130/2

****************
*Related but not quite the same issues:*
- #7538
- #7079

issue.body:
## Describe your changes
### We're seeing weird behaviors in input widgets in an enter-to-submit enabled forms.
The "Press X to submit" instruction shows correctly while changing the input. It however does not show again when we leave and then re-focus on the input, even when we can still enter to submit at this point. (See [linked issue](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/7079) for more detailed repro steps)

### Pervalance
This is happening to all widgets using `<InputInstructions />`
* `TextInput`
* `TextArea`
* `NumberInput`

*except for `ChatInput`, who is using it only for the word count

### In this PR
This PR changed the behavior such that if an input is 1) in a form 2) allowed to enter to submit and 3) focused, we would show the input instructions. 

We don't look at `dirty` state in this case, because we **do not block** enter-to-submit action if the exact same input has just been submitted. (We look at `dirty` state if the input is not in form, because we do block enter-to-apply if the same input has just been applied.)

This PR also added new test cases to test the scenario from the GH issue and updated existing ones to validate the new checks on focused state.

## GitHub Issue Link
[#7079](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/7079)

## Testing Plan
- [x] JS Unit Tests
- [x] Manual testing
